summary: Phase 2 testing complete. Backend (20/20 pytest cases PASS) and frontend end-to-end flow all working: public catalog (list/featured/brands/detail with sensitive-field redaction and TAYANG-only visibility), customer registration (password mismatch 400, duplicate 409, promo consent object persisted), addresses CRUD with first-is-default rule, promo-consent toggle (revoked_at/consented_at), cart (empty state, add TAYANG+TERSEDIA unit, snapshot fields, duplicate idempotent, DRAFT rejection 400, remove, admin 403), inventory history_harga/history_status arrays. Frontend: beranda renders hero+featured+brand pills; /katalog renders grid; /produk/:id shows Rp 9.500.000 harga + badge Tersedia + add-to-cart button that redirects anonymous users to /masuk?redirect=/produk/:id; /daftar form has promo checkbox defaulting UNCHECKED with correct text (promosi/diskon/penawaran produk/program pembayaran); register redirects to /akun; add alamat works and badge Utama auto; add-to-cart as pelanggan increments StoreLayout cart-badge; /keranjang shows subtotal Rp 9.500.000, checkout disabled with 'Checkout (Fase 3)' label; remove -> cart-empty; logout works; admin /admin/inventaris/:id shows 'Riwayat Perubahan' panel with two columns (Harga Jual, Status Stok) populated with timestamp dd/BULAN/yyyy and 'oleh owner@tokohp.id'.

issues: Hanya 1 brand pill terdeteksi (data seed terbatas: 2 TAYANG unit setelah testing). Bukan bug; dataset kecil.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_customer.cart GET uses /api/customer (root) which collides semantically with 'customer collection'. Consider /api/customer/cart for clarity, but works as-is.
routes_catalog featured() falls back only when len<limit; fine.
No rate-limiting on /api/auth/register could enable mass signup abuse - consider captcha/throttle in later phase.
AddressCreate used for PATCH requires all required fields on partial update; consider AddressUpdate with Optional fields.
Cart snapshot stored only at display time (fetched live from units each GET). If unit removed, item silently filtered out - fine but no 'produk dihapus' indicator.
test_credentials: Owner: owner@tokohp.id / Admin@12345. Testing agent registered TEST_pel_*@example.id and TEST_fe_*@example.id with password Pelanggan@123.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ~3 Apple iPhone 13 / Samsung A52 / Oppo Reno units (prefixed with TEST deskripsi). Primary TAYANG unit id f5dd3e25-c6fd-4fb4-ac15-b7cf5bdd09b9 reset to TERSEDIA for FE flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 fully green. For Phase 3 (checkout/pembayaran), reuse owner creds and register new TEST_* pelanggan. Note: pytest.ini addopts enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope; module-scoped register fixture distributes OK across workers only if entire test module stays on 1 worker. Our test_phase2.py uses -n 0 if needed; works with default -n 2 loadscope since all customer tests in same module.
